title: Wso2am: In Apache CXF, the parser for multipart/MTOM attachment part headers did not fully enforce… (CVE-2026-107937)
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package affects Apache CXF's parser for multipart/MTOM attachment part headers. The parser did not fully enforce configured limits on attachment header size and count, potentially leading to denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 4.7.0-r4. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.5 and does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability.
